title: Sysfs: add fips_enforcement attribute to document rmmod-only deactivation
description:
The fact that FIPS enforcement (fips_provider_count > 0) can only be deactivated by unloading all FIPS provider modules is documented in registry.c:37-43 as a code comment only. No running-system observable. CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_STATUS exposes fips_state but no deactivation explanation.

Fix: add a read-only sysfs attribute fips_enforcement to the crypto2dev misc device in src/cdev/crypto2dev_cdev.c. Readable at /sys/class/misc/crypto2dev/fips_enforcement. Output: 'active (deactivate with: rmmod <provider_name>)' listing each loaded FIPS provider, or 'inactive' when fips_provider_count == 0. Implement as a simple device_attribute using the existing sysfs infrastructure already present in crypto2dev_cdev.c (alongside the algorithms attribute).
